entry.title: New: Resolution 307 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR A MULTI-YEAR LEASE FOR ONE MULTI-FUNCTION COPY MACHINE FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement at an approximate monthly cost of $91, to be used by the department’s Traffic Administration Section in Hilo.
